sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The general entry shows a branch network: the northern outer Parabolica, both central loop closures, the direct central connection and the southern infield hairpin. The four independently identified component routes cover those branches. The inner Parabolica shortcut, southern hairpin bypass and parallel pit access are excluded because they are absent from the supplied branch identity. The independent unique branch distance is 2889.9 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
